description: Na₃Li₃Mn₂P₂(CO₇)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.92 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.87 Å. There are three inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.42 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.44 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.47 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.22 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.23 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Li, and one C atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂LiC tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂MnP tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one Na, two Li, and one C atom.
